name: Bio-Oil
lead: Bio-Oil is a commercial skincare oil marketed for improving the appearance of scars, stretch marks and uneven skin tone. It is a branded cosmetic product, not a drug.

Peer-reviewed literature on the specific product was not available to this wiki at the time of writing, so the evidence summary below is limited to what general references say about stretch marks. A Wikipedia summary reports a Cochrane systematic review finding no evidence that creams or oils prevent or reduce stretch marks in pregnancy.[1]
infobox: Scars, stretch marks, uneven skin tone

paras: No studies found for the branded product in the references reviewed. Studies of other oils and creams for stretch marks are summarized in general references: the Cochrane review mentioned above found no evidence of prevention or reduction with creams or oils in pregnancy, and evidence for reducing established marks is described as limited.[1]
The product is discussed in skincare forums as a popular over-the-counter stretch mark and scar oil; the wiki holds no cited forum material on it.

card.summary: Popular scar and stretch mark oil with no product-specific evidence found here.
card.note: Sources for this product were thin.

quick.overview:
Bio-Oil is a branded cosmetic oil marketed for scars and stretch marks.

Sources reviewed contain no product-specific trials; general references say creams and oils have not been shown to prevent stretch marks in pregnancy.
quick.mechanism: Moisturizing oils soften skin surface; no mechanism for changing scar or stretch mark structure was established in the sources reviewed.
quick.risks: No safety data were found in the sources reviewed. As a cosmetic, it is not subject to drug approval.
